slices.title: Fix first-push slice commit governance
slices.description: Ensure pre-push governance checks every outgoing commit on branches with no upstream, not only HEAD.
acceptanceCriteria: A pre-push contract test covers a no-upstream branch with multiple outgoing commits.
An earlier commit missing ASK-Slice or ASK-Exempt fails pre-push even when HEAD is exempt.
Existing upstream-based pre-push behavior remains unchanged.

slices.title: Make runtime sequence allocation concurrency-safe
slices.description: Serialize SequenceStore.next() so concurrent ASK runtimes cannot allocate duplicate event sequence numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: A concurrent SequenceStore contract test returns unique contiguous values.
Sequence state persists the correct nextSeq after concurrent allocation.
Lock acquisition has bounded retry behavior and deterministic failure.

slices.title: Run integration commands in a real git worktree
slices.description: Replace empty integration runtime directories with actual git worktrees so integration commands validate repository content.
acceptanceCriteria: A contract test proves integration commands can read repo files in the provisioned workspace.
Integration workspace cleanup uses git worktree cleanup semantics.
Integration status and merge-readiness projections remain deterministic.

slices.title: Make plan ingestion durable and recoverable
slices.description: Record batch state before materialization events and complete or fail the batch deterministically.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan ingest records pending batch state before materialization events.
Interrupted or failed ingestion leaves diagnosable batch state.
Duplicate detection accounts for pending, completed, and failed batches.

slices.title: Prevent slice close from committing unrelated work
slices.description: Fail closed or scope staging so ask slice close does not sweep unrelated dirty files into one ASK-Slice commit.
acceptanceCriteria: A slice-close contract test covers pre-existing unrelated dirty files.
Slice close does not complete the task before the dirty-worktree guard passes.
Existing clean-worktree slice close behavior remains unchanged.

slices.title: Align ASK Core package version metadata
slices.description: Update ask-core package metadata and release notes so v5.0.0 is reflected consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Root package version and ask-core package version both report 5.0.0.
v5.0.0 release notes clearly describe the runtime expansion.
Full test suite passes after metadata alignment.
